reviews.summary: SAND has current venue/liquidity and security-overhang risks: GMO Coin’s SAND service wind-down begins today, October 7, 2026, and The Sandbox’s August bridge exploit remains under compensation/remediation.
materialRisks: GMO Coin began its SAND delisting/wind-down timetable on October 7, 2026; spot-service and deposit closure are scheduled for October 24. This is venue-specific but can add liquidity/flow risk. ([coin.z.com](https://coin.z.com/jp/news/2026/09/16483/?utm_source=openai))

The Sandbox disclosed an August 2026 bridge exploit involving unbacked SAND minting and approximately 14.74M SAND removed from Ethereum collateral; affected bridges were closed and the project was still administering compensation in September. ([sandbox.game](https://www.sandbox.game/en/blog/august-22-exploit-post-mortem/3526/?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The affected exploit path was Base/BSC bridge configuration; The Sandbox stated Ethereum SAND supply was unchanged and Polygon was not exposed to that compromised path.
Bybit EU ended SAND spot trading on September 15, 2026, after a compliance/performance review; this is a recent additional venue-loss signal.
SAND’s published vesting schedule ended in 2025, so no scheduled vesting unlock appears imminent.
